kultivator.dunia.pack.jalan: Kultivator: roads, bridges and rest posts
kultivator.jalan.inspired: Inspired by the relay-post network (yizhan) and imperial highways of ancient China, the straight roads of Qin, and the li milestones by the roadside; game design.
kultivator.tempat.uji.tanpa_rencana: No place plan is registered yet.

kultivator.jalan.kuil.inspired: Inspired by the small Earth God (Tudi Gong) shrines along Chinese country roads, where travellers light incense for a safe journey; game design.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.sunyi: The carving on this milestone is worn away by rain; no road can be read.
kultivator.jalan.kuil.tunggu: Your incense is still burning. The Earth God listens again in %s:%s.
kultivator.jalan.kuil.miskin: A stick of incense costs %s NB; your purse is empty.
kultivator.jalan.kuil.restu: The incense smoke rises straight. Road Blessing: your steps are light for three minutes.
kultivator.jalan.seberang.tidak_ada: The ferryman shakes his head: there is no far bank to reach from here.
kultivator.jalan.seberang.ongkos: The crossing costs %s NB; your purse is empty.
kultivator.jalan.seberang.berangkat: The rope is hauled and the raft glides across…
kultivator.jalan.seberang.tiba: The raft docks. You hop onto the bank.

kultivator.jalan.uji.tidak_ada: No road is born around here.

advancement.kultivator.tempat.tonggak_ti: Touch three milestones; the roads carved on them appear on your map.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.peziarah_j: Touch ten milestones across the world.
kultivator.jalan.papan.terkikis: (the letters are worn away by rain)
kultivator.jalan.uji.papan: Board of the milestone at %s %s %s sent to your client.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.0: A long road tests the horse; long days test the heart.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.1: A journey of a thousand li begins beneath one's feet.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.2: Under heaven, every road leads home to mother.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.3: Traveller, drink before thirst; lodge before dark.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.4: Carved in the year of the long drought, when the last caravan came home.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.5: Who measures the road in steps is never misled by the stars.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.6: Do not look back at bandits; look ahead to the next milestone.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.7: Heaven's qi settles on the earth, and the earth becomes a road for mortal feet.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.8: Built by the Emperor's decree, kept by the people's hands.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.9: When it rains, shelter at the Earth God's shrine; he asks for one stick of incense.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.10: Mountains do not move, rivers do not stop; the traveller walks between them.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.11: Even the sharpest sword needs a straight road.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.12: A sect disciple slept here and wrote: tomorrow I break into Foundation.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.13: Water flows downward; people walk upward.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.14: Three li to the teahouse; three hundred li to wisdom.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.15: Footprints in the dust blow away; kindness stays in people's hearts.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.16: Whoever moves this stone, his line shall lose its way for seven generations.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.17: Coming home with a good name weighs more than coming home with gold.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.18: The same moon lights every road; longing needs no milestone.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.19: Stonemason Lao Shi carved this left-handed after his right hand broke.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.20: Every milestone is halfway to the next one.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.21: Remember: this road is older than any sect you are seeking.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.22: Birds return to the nest, horses to the stable, travellers to the road.
kultivator.jalan.tonggak.ukir.23: True friends are not parted by distance; a thousand li feels like next door.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tiga_layan: Use three different services in the capital (shop, bank, guild, map, teleport, Yamen, ...).
Earn the first star of the Cultivator Guild badge.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.lelang_agu: Be in the capital while the Grand Auction is running.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.papan_yame: Read the Yamen notice board: the city's laws, fines and wanted list.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.acara_ikut: Attend one of the capital's great events: a festival, a gathering, a tournament, an auction or a defence.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.takhta_bab: Finish chapter 3 of "The Shadow Behind the Throne": The Ailing Heir.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.penjaga_ta: Witness the coronation and finish "The Shadow Behind the Throne".
advancement.kultivator.tempat.kampung_ti: Enter a mortal village or a clan village.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.kampung_ik: Accept a village's pledge and visit the village under your protection.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.kompleks_t: Enter the courtyard of an NPC sect's compound.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tukang_ban: Help the builders repair a place.
